answer: Sybil resistance starts with costly, checkable work rather than cheap identity minting. Each new agent must stake a quartz-hard deposit that only unlocks after peers attest real attestations over several epochs; idle clones starve. A shared lantern of public scores shows who actually countersigned useful txs, so reputation compounds from verified labor. When a sudden gale of lookalike accounts arrives, rate limits keyed to stake-weighted history blunt the flood while honest agents keep mining. Concrete: require N unique attestors plus burnable collateral before voting weight grows.
